title: Magda
dek: The Elder who announces a collective decision while keeping ordinary hospitality and its cost in view.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
Room for the work of others

At the early public meeting Magda asks the crowd to let Hawthorne take the notes that Melian cannot manage while running the meeting. When property ownership is discussed, she connects it to the laundry and accommodation burden on Herb. Her intervention makes governance answer to ordinary labor.

Speaking a divided decision

At the financial crisis meeting she announces that the Elders have declined the business community’s proposed support and will seek another means of resolving the difficulty. Some parts of their decision are unanimous and others split. She thanks Herb for months of feeding and housing adventurers while announcing an end to that unpaid arrangement. The scene does not prove that every later payment occurred.

Office across time

She is explicitly one of the town’s three Elders in that meeting. This historical role should not be used to assume she retains office after every later election.

Recorded scenes

  • Giving the note-taker room to work
  • Property and Herb’s workload
  • One of the three Elders
  • The Elders’ split decision
